document.text:
Psychologist Zarko Trebjesanin says that children should not be trained to use weapons, but to communicate tolerantly.
Sociologist Ratko Bozovic said this, among other things: “Throwing bombs and firing rifles are an attraction for the children and they find self-confirmation in such acts of violence.”
